sources.title: BOOX Super Refresh (BSR): Technology That Brings Silky Refresh And Razor-sharp Visuals
excerpts: Fast Mode aims at a smooth experience of browsing websites or activities that involve lots of scrolling. Subtle ghosting may occur but responsiveness is enhanced.
Ultrafast mode provides the most rapid response to dynamic content. Though some detail would be lost it enables you to watch videos and seamlessly use different apps.

sources.scope: 当次仅核对可读取页面标题；参数为宣传图片，未将其他机型参数外推到此机

excerpts: Pls use black and white (16 level gray scale) as the main color of pages;
Pls don’t add transparent layers on images or texts;
Pls use the page based way to load more contents;
Pls try to avoid animation, such as scrolling/dragging etc.
The font size should not be smaller than 14sp;
ANIMATION: black/white screen update, faster than DU, but lower quality
